scope: Shared electrical transient, rolling state, live beam, deterministic CPU operators. Linux Node/WASM; no Apple M1 or physical-machine accuracy claim.

tests.name: Shared deck directly wires U2/U7 into transistor selectors and loaded scope
Actual adaptive beam trace is finite, monotone and reaches all display axes
Rolling checkpoints retain ball, transistor phases and external sine time
woscope beam integral agrees with numerical Gaussian quadrature
Phosphor uses simulated time; repeated presentation adds no energy
Real joint electrical trace produces a screen without geometric game objects
CPU versus CPU runs through multiple rallies/checkpoints with bounded memory

screen.input: plate X/Y and beam current only
